logp.method_description: The n-octanol-water coefficients of the complexes were determined using a shake-flask method, as reported previously [58]. Briefly, 100 mL buffered-saline (0.15 M NaCl, 10 mM phosphate [PO43-] buffer, pH 7.4) and 100 mL n-octanol were shaken for 72 h. The addition of 1 mg of the complexes followed by the centrifugation and separation of both phases gave two solutions, which were analysed by UV absorbance spectroscopy to determine their concentration in each phase. The corresponding value of log P was defined as log{[compound(organic)]/[compound(aqueous)]}.
